annotations.text: M1 locked — the whole app in the final direction. Home: machine cards + banner hero pinned in the thumb zone. First run walks you straight into adding a connection. Settings holds the hero picker + style (banner/dial/mini all ship), the tile assignment, and connections.

Editors: a connection is authenticated once (test fetches its commands as proof). A machine picks a connection and checks off which of its commands become buttons — PING marks ones that can report awake/online. Swap a machine's connection later and its buttons re-aim, exactly the red→green trick.
